headline: Centrica CEO Warns Rising Energy Bills Will Drive Up Unpaid Consumer Debt
summary: Centrica Chief Executive Chris O'Shea expressed deep concern over soaring energy bills, stating more customers will be unable to pay when prices rise in the new year.
why: Centrica is the largest domestic energy supplier in the United Kingdom and operator of British Gas.

impacts.name: Centrica
impacts.why: Centrica warned higher retail energy prices could increase customer payment defaults.
